meta.title: Adding a vendor to a live auction works where allowed
gaps: The prepared live state provides an RFQ pricing round rather than a live auction, and no step can create or open the specified live auction state without changing the test setup.
The gate that allows audience edits cannot be enabled or verified by any catalog step.
No catalog step can sign in as the newly added second vendor and verify that vendor's event visibility and biddability in the supplier portal.

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Participants tab without creating or searching for another event.
Add a vendor from the product's available vendor list to the current round.
Verify the added vendor is selected and has an available Add Bid control.
Verify that adding the vendor increased the round's participant count by one.
